# reolink_motion_detection (Resource)

Manages conventional Reolink motion sensitivity using GetMdAlarm and SetMdAlarm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reolink_motion_detection" "front" {
  camera      = "front"
  channel     = 0
  sensitivity = 25
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.
- `sensitivity` (Number) Uniform all-day motion sensitivity.

### Optional

- `channel` (Number) Zero-based camera channel. Defaults to 0.
- `scope` (String) Camera-native motion detection mask bit string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reolink_motion_detection.front front/0
```
